question: For the TCGA cancer cohorts in the HPA cancer prognostics, give a grouped bar chart of the number of validated favourable versus validated unfavourable prognostic genes per cancer, a dot plot of the ten cancers with the most prognostic genes in total, and the table behind both.

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input: {"query": "SELECT DISTINCT Cancer FROM cancer_prognostic_data ORDER BY Cancer"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "SELECT "Cancer",
       SUM(TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - favorable" AS INTEGER)) AS val_fav,
       SUM(TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - unfavorable" AS INTEGER)) AS val_unfav
FROM cancer_prognostic_data
GROUP BY "Cancer"
ORDER BY "Cancer""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "SELECT "Gene", "Cancer", "potential prognostic - favorable", "potential prognostic - unfavorable",
       "validated prognostic - favorable", "validated prognostic - unfavorable"
FROM cancer_prognostic_data
WHERE "validated prognostic - favorable" IS NOT NULL
LIMIT 10"}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "SELECT "Cancer",
       COUNT("validated prognostic - favorable") AS n_val_fav_any,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_val_fav_lt1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - favorable" AS DOUBLE) < 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_val_fav_lt005,
       COUNT("validated prognostic - unfavorable") AS n_val_unfav_any,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - unfavorable" AS DOUBLE) < 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_val_unfav_lt1,
       SUM(CASE WHEN TRY_CAST("validated prognostic - unfavorable" AS DOUBLE) < 0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_val_unfav_lt005
FROM cancer_prognostic_data
WHERE "Cancer" LIKE '%(TCGA)'
GROUP BY "Cancer"
ORDER BY "Cancer""}

tool_uses.name: sql
tool_uses.input:
{"query": "SELECT "Cancer",
       COUNT("validated prognostic - favorable") AS validated_favourable,
       COUNT("validated prognostic - unfavorable") AS validated_unfavourable,
       COUNT("validated prognostic - favorable") + COUNT("validated prognostic - unfavorable") AS total
FROM cancer_prognostic_data
WHERE "Cancer" LIKE '%(TCGA)'
GROUP BY "Cancer"
ORDER BY total DESC, "Cancer""}

blood_immunoassay_concentration (0.1 MB): gene, ENSG ID, conc [pg/L], sample type, number_of_samples, pubmed id
blood_ms_concentration (0.1 MB): Gene, ENSG ID, Conc [pg/L]
blood_pea_disease_de (17.9 MB): Gene, ENSG ID, Disease, Class, Control, logFC, p-value adjusted, Seeds, Mean importance, SD importance, Max importance, Min importance
blood_pea_diseases (0.0 MB): Disease, Class
cancer_cancers (0.0 MB): Cancer, Organ
cancer_cptac (5.7 MB): Cancer, Gene, Gene name, p
